name: application-segment-breakdown-bar
title: Segment Breakdown Bar
description: Single horizontal stacked bar splitting a total into labeled, colored segments with a legend — each segment's width is computed from its real share of the total, not hand-placed.
useWhen: Showing how a total splits into a small number of categories in a single, compact horizontal bar.
You want a lighter-weight alternative to a donut chart when vertical space is tight (e.g. inside a table row or card header).
The legend below the bar should list every segment's exact percentage, not just imply it from bar width.
avoidWhen: You're comparing two named categories head-to-head — use comparison-stat-pair instead.
You need to rank several distinct rows against each other — use stat-comparison-bars instead.
The breakdown has many categories (8+) — thin slivers become unreadable; use a table instead.
responsiveBehavior: The bar is full-width and its segments are percentage-based, so it scales fluidly with its container; the legend wraps onto multiple lines as needed.
accessibility: Each bar segment carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the category name, raw value, and percentage together.
Every segment also appears in the visible legend with a color swatch, label, and percentage.
Segment color is supplementary — the legend's text always carries the precise data.

variants.title: Segment breakdown bar
variants.description: Three-segment traffic-by-device bar (Desktop 55%, Mobile 38%, Tablet 7%) with a legend, on a light surface.
accessibility: Percentages are rounded consistently between the bar's aria-labels and the visible legend.

variants.title: Segment breakdown bar (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-segment traffic-by-device bar, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Segment and legend text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
